spindle.console.World.title: World
spindle.console.World.description: What a reset loads once every store is empty, the body of `POST /api/reset`; every member is optional and no other is read. An empty or all-whitespace body loads no world: the run starts from empty stores, its own answers and a random mint. A world loaded holds until the next reset, which drops its decisions and its mint. Only `b10x-spindle run` loads a world; a run that loads none (`play --component`, the browser run) refuses a reset with a body `400`. Source: `crates/spindle-cli/src/world.rs:1-81`, `crates/spindle-ingress/src/console.rs:112-130`, `crates/spindle-cli/src/serve.rs:325-349`, `crates/spindle-cli/src/cli.rs:141-146`.

rows.description: The rows written once every store is empty, in order; absent for none. Two rows of one instance are refused (`crates/spindle-host/src/host.rs:897-902`).

decisions.description: A decision table in the decisions file's shape, `{"<outcome>": true | false, "<command>": {"<outcome>": true | false}}`, each key an external outcome or a command that declares one. It answers external causes before `--decisions` and `--answer-default` do, until the next reset; an answer from it is the `world` source of `spindle.observe.AnswerSource`. Source: `crates/spindle-host/src/decisions.rs:47-59`, `crates/spindle-cli/src/decisions.rs:35-44`.

mint.description: The seed every identity and generated value is minted from until the next reset, so the same requests mint the same identities; absent for random version 4 UUIDs. A seeded mint never answers a UUID a row's identity holds or ends in. Source: `crates/spindle-host/src/host.rs:101-112,874-879,913-937`.

spindle.console.WorldRow.title: WorldRow
spindle.console.WorldRow.description: One row of a world: an instance of a declared entity as it rests, written once every store is empty, where its entity rests. ESS checks it against the model as it checks a scenario's `establish` step; the run then checks that a running component owns its entity, that its invariants hold, that its store can key its identity and that no other row of the world is the same instance. Source: `crates/spindle-cli/src/world.rs:39-47,83-113`, `crates/spindle-host/src/host.rs:881-911`.

entity.description: The qualified name of the entity the row is an instance of.

identity.description: The instance's identity, a value of the entity's identity type.

state.description: The lifecycle state the row rests in, one the entity declares.

fields.description: The row's fields by name, each a value of its declared type; absent for none. A field sent as `null` is held as absent (`crates/spindle-cli/src/world.rs:99-104`).
